params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from TaskDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `nsites` `elements` `nelements` `composition` `composition_reduced` `formula_pretty` `formula_anonymous` `chemsys` `volume` `density` `density_atomic` `symmetry` `batch_id` `calc_type` `completed_at` `dir_name` `icsd_id` `input` `last_updated` `orig_inputs` `output` `run_type` `structure` `tags` `task_id` `task_type` `transformations` `vasp_objects` `vasp_version` `additional_json` `analysis` `author` `calcs_reversed` `custodian` `entry` `included_objects` `run_stats` `state` `task_label`
